title: Hook Invocation Event (CloudEvents v1.0)
description: Single entry in data/hook-invocations.jsonl. CloudEvents v1.0 envelope + framework-specific extension fields. Per roadmap 260523 §15.6 P1 item 8 (JSON Schema per event_type).

ts.description: Legacy ISO timestamp (kept for backward compat with pre-§15 readers).

hook.description: Hook class name or script name.

error.description: Plaintext OR `enc::<base64>` envelope when crypto-shredding active (§15 P0 subtask 4).

id.description: CloudEvents required: unique event identifier (UUID v4).

type.description: CloudEvents required: reverse-DNS event type. Prefix `com.anthropic.claude.hook.<event_name>`.

time.description: CloudEvents required: event occurrence time (== ts).

correlationid.description: CloudEvents extension: groups all events from one slash-run/session.

causationid.description: CloudEvents extension: parent event id (DAG causality). Empty for roots.
